content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The record ends with the bare statement that the Agency concluded Complainant 'failed to prove' discrimination, but it never defines Claims 1 and 2 or shows any reasoning connecting the documented evidence (e.g., Complainant appearing to perform the seven 'essential functions' from Florida before relocation) to that conclusion."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Most statements are attributed to named RMOs, the FOHS Doctor, or evaluations, but several material characterizations lack an underlying source: RMO1's 'low productivity' and 'lowest of any full-time employee' claims, the 'unannounced disconnection' episodes, and RMO2's admittedly second-hand testimony; RMO6 is also said to be uncontacted yet to have testified in August 2018."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"The relocation and accommodation sequence is well dated (September 27, 2016 through August 16, 2017), but other points are vague or inconsistent: the original telework grant is dated only 'late 2010 or early 2011,' S1's supervision period (November 2014 to May 2015) conflicts with her October 2015 signature on the FY 2014 evaluation, the PIP has no dates, the FY 2015 evaluation is missing, and RMO6's August 2018 testimony postdates the February 23, 2018 FAD request."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who issued the FAD or what legal standard was applied; the Agency's rationale shifts between undue hardship (RMO4's December 11, 2017 affidavit) and inability to perform seven essential functions; only six numbered functions plus unnumbered text appear; and there is no indication that Complainant's rebuttal or his alternative reassignment proposals were weighed before finalization."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Given the missing reasoning, unresolved contradictions in testimony, the absent FY 2015 evaluation, truncated passages (e.g., 'due to undue hardship 5'), and the unidentified decision process, an independent reviewer could not assess from the record alone whether the conclusion is supported."}}}
